note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). F-16C Block 50 ASF: an air-superiority copy of the F-16C Fighting Falcon card in the Stryker Cavalry regiment, with the loadout from Osama's screenshot built in: inner pylons 2x fuel tanks (+20), middle pylons 2x AIM-120 AMRAAM (+35), outer pylons 2x AIM-9 and 2x AIM-120 (+45), ECM pod (+30). Card total 240 (110 base). Same model, armor, speed, gun, sensors and availability (2) as the F-16C; the F-16C card is unchanged. Name: Block 50 (with the APG-83 radar upgrade) is the most modern F-16 the US Air Force flies; Block 70/72 is export only. Name only, no stat change. Not yet run in a game.
